Tooltip_GodSystem_MimicKey: One use. Right-click a locked vanilla door, key padlock, or vehicle to create its matching permanent key. Combination locks are removed and returned as a combination padlock. Doors and vehicles remain locked.
Tooltip_GodSystem_UtilityGenerator: When started, supplies power in the vanilla generator range. Select squares and bind plumbed fixtures or fixed water containers individually; each target defaults to 10 L and existing water sources take priority. Water and power have separate accounts. Anyone can operate it; balances and bindings stay with the device.
